title: Valley Fold
description: The paper folds toward you, making a valley.

steps.title: Fold in half
steps.instruction: Fold the bottom edge up to the top edge.
tips: Line up the corners first, then press the crease from the middle out.
mistakes: Pressing the crease before the edges meet.

steps.title: Unfold
tips: The crease now dips away from you like a valley.

steps.title: Diagonal valley
steps.instruction: Fold the bottom-right corner to the top-left corner.
tips: Hold the corners together with one finger while you crease.
